summary: Backend-only testing completed successfully. All 8 API endpoints tested and verified working correctly. MySQL connectivity confirmed, data seeding verified (10 projects, 4 posts, 5 faqs, 7 team, 1 site_content), self-hosted image paths validated, filtering functionality working, and individual resource retrieval by slug operational.
passed_tests: GET /api/ - Identity JSON with message='Homeland Group Mohali API', status='ok', version, build, started_at
GET /api/health - Returns status='ok', mysql.ok=true, content counts (projects=10, posts=4, faqs=5, team=7, site_content=1)
GET /api/projects - Returns array of 10 projects with hero_image starting with /projects/
GET /api/projects?status=UPCOMING - Returns filtered subset of 5 UPCOMING projects
GET /api/content - Returns site content with contact_email
GET /api/projects/cp67 - Returns single project by slug
